loose.ch: the chi-square probability (chisqsum - avg * chisum) is a cancellation to rounding noise; abs is 4 times the largest move of R own value under eight perturbed integrands (2e-16 to 1e-14), rel 1e-8; every other cuhre quantity is exact or rel 1e-9
loose.dv: divonne partitioning follows an optimiser whose steps compare function values: a case whose own R result moves under a 1e-15 or 1e-14 perturbed integrand gets error rel 1e-5 and the evaluation count a 0.2 percent allowance; the chi-square probability is abs 0.02; stable cases are exact
loose.vg_sv: seeded draws equal R (Mersenne Twister, same seed), rel 1e-9
